text:
maya: Quick follow-up from PM-2026-03 (latency cascade) 00: consolidated action list + owners. Please ack or reassign within 48h.

1) Implement per-model backpressure + telemetry (JIRA-4999) - proposed owner: rajesh - target: 2w
2) Canary rollback hook in deployer (JIRA-5000) - proposed owner: sam + eng-deploy (pair) - target: 1w
3) Postmortem recurrence checklist + auto-tag (internal task) - proposed owner: eva - target: 3d
4) Runbook + playbook test (JIRA-5001) - proposed owner: eva - target: 5d
5) KV cache eviction postmortem deep-dive (JIRA-5002) - proposed owner: rajesh - target: 1w

rajesh: Ack JIRA-4999 and JIRA-5002. For 4999 I'll add a metrics dashboard (p99/p95/p50 by model + inflight). Plan: draft PR next Tue, estimation 3 dev-days.

sam: Ack JIRA-5000. Need eng-deploy to be listed as Consulted. Sam (R), eng-deploy (C), Maya (A), Rajesh (I). I'll open the subtask for the rollback hook tests.

eva: I'll own the checklist and runbook test (JIRA-5001). For the checklist I propose fields: "occurrence_count", "mitigation_timeline", "repro_steps", "recurrence_flagged". Will push PR to docs today.

ops-bot: Created JIRA-5000.1 for rollback hook test harness: https://jira.redwood.local/browse/JIRA-5000.1

maya: Two process asks: a) add a recurrence-review field on postmortems with >2 repeats (auto-tag), b) require a remediation-verification comment with deployment SHA and verification steps before closure.

rajesh: For 4999 I'll also prototype a short-term throttle we can flip via feature flag if spikes reappear. Could be useful as a mitigation before full rollout.

sam: Good idea. If you want, create a tiny RFC in #eng-platform and I'll review. Also @maya can we get a 15m sync with eng-deploy to align interfaces?

maya: Scheduled 15m sync tomorrow 11:30 PT and added recurrence-review automation to the postmortem board.

eva: PR: https://github.com/redwood/ops-runbooks/pull/902 - adds checklist template + example filled for PM-2026-03. Includes a small test script to validate runbook steps.

rajesh: I'll attach KV eviction time series and heap dumps to JIRA-5002 by EOD Monday. Noted repeated spikes at ~03:10 UTC.

sam: I opened JIRA-5000.1 and assigned eng-deploy. Please add testcases for partial rollouts and simulated failure mode.

maya: Reminder: when marking tasks done please add comment "remediation-verification" with SHA and link to perf traces and @postmortem-owners. We'll close PM ticket after verification.

rajesh: Ack. If anyone needs a swap, call it out here. If no objections, I'll start on the dashboard and throttle patch.

eva: No objections. Thanks all.

maya: Closing for owner assignment after 48h; reopen if you need swaps. Thanks.
